name: Ginnethon
overview: Ginnethon, also referred to as Ginnetho, appears in the book of Nehemiah as a companion of Nehemiah during the post-exilic restoration of Jerusalem. The brief mentions in Nehemiah 10:6, 12:4, and 12:16 identify Ginnethon among the leaders and priests who participated in the covenant renewal and the organization of the community. These references highlight Ginnethon's role within the faithful remnant committed to God’s covenant and the rebuilding efforts under Nehemiah's leadership.
